scalars.scalar_value: Must have at least 3 years of recent high volume phlebotomy laboratory experience
Monday – Friday, shifts may start as early as 6:30am or as late as 9:00am with rotating weekends and holidays

items.item_text: Current and valid California State CPT certificate
High school diploma or equivalent (e.g. GED or HiSET)
Must have at least 3 years of recent high volume phlebotomy laboratory experience
Join our team as a Hospital Laboratory Technician III and play a critical role in supporting patient care across our laboratory network. Key duties include:
Provide float coverage for nine BURL draw stations and CRI, including Lead-level support as needed
Perform specimen processing activities, including labeling, centrifugation, aliquoting, receiving, and handling unacceptable specimens according to established procedures
Perform accurate patient registration, order entry, and computer data entry functions
Assist supervisors with preparation of preliminary daily and monthly staffing schedules
Coordinate courier services and transportation routes, and follow up on service delays or operational issues
Assist with validation, testing, and implementation of new processes, software systems, and laboratory equipment
Serve as the Beaker Clinical Pathology (CP) Subject Matter Expert (SME) and provide operational support and guidance
Support laboratory operations by assisting team members with workflow, inventory management, clerical duties, and other operational needs
Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite

Ability to work at various draw stations as needed (e.g. Westlake Village, Thousand Oaks, Woodland Hills, Santa Clarita, Porter Ranch, Calabasas, Burbank, Century City, Encino, Panorama City and Torrance).
Availability to work weekends, holidays and other shifts as needed
